items.headline: Senator seeks records on Tether payments to ex-adviser's firm
items.summary: Senator Richard Blumenthal, the top Democrat on a Senate investigations subcommittee, has requested records on stablecoin issuer Tether's reported payments to Nxum, a consulting firm co-founded by Bo Hines, a former White House crypto adviser.
items.sourceTitle: Senator probes Tether’s reported $6 million payments to ex-White House crypto adviser’s firm

items.headline: Franklin Templeton moves $150M in fund shares onto XRP Ledger
items.summary: Franklin Templeton added about $150 million in fund tokens to the XRP Ledger through two subscriptions on Thursday, nearly quadrupling its existing tokens on the network. All of them landed in a single wallet.
items.sourceTitle: Franklin Templeton adds $150 million in fund shares to XRP Ledger, all in one wallet

items.headline: OCC stablecoin rule changes redemption timing and bank obligations
items.summary: A new OCC rule for stablecoin issuers sets how the two-business-day redemption limit ends, with bank availability assessed separately. The excerpt gives few further details.
items.sourceTitle: New OCC stablecoin rule resets redemptions, and banks face big shifts

items.headline: Wells Fargo and Five Others Oppose OKX-ICE Tokenized Stock Plan
items.summary: Reportedly, Wells Fargo and five other firms have objected to the OKX-ICE joint venture's proposed tokenized stock platform. The objections were filed under the SEC's innovation exemption.
items.sourceTitle: Wells Fargo and five others object to OKX-ICE tokenized stock listings: Report

items.headline: New York Seeks $1.37B Judgment Against NovaTech Crypto Operators
items.summary: New York's attorney general is asking a court to order the operators of a crypto Ponzi scheme to repay investors, with interest. The alleged frauds took more than $1.1 billion from investors.
items.sourceTitle: NY Seeks $1.37 Billion Judgment Against Operators of NovaTech Crypto Ponzi Scheme

items.headline: Blockstream Starts Institutional Consulting Arm and Opens Lugano Office
items.summary: Blockstream plans to offer its engineering expertise to banks and asset managers from a new office in Lugano, Switzerland.
items.sourceTitle: Blockstream Launches Institutional Consulting Services, Opens Lugano Office

items.headline: UK regulator says some crypto apps may need licences for automated routing
items.summary: The FCA's proposed guidance distinguishes between technical access and substantive involvement in transactions, as firms prepare for the UK's crypto regime starting October 2027.
items.sourceTitle: UK’s FCA says crypto apps may need licenses when algorithms choose trade routes

items.headline: Senator Blumenthal Seeks Tether Records on Payments to Nxum
items.summary: Sen. Richard Blumenthal has requested Tether's records concerning payments made to Nxum, a firm co-owned by former White House crypto adviser Bo Hines.
items.sourceTitle: Senate Democrat Probes Tether Payments to Ex-White House Crypto Adviser’s Firm

items.headline: SEC Lists AI Superintelligence and Tokenization Among Market Risks
items.summary: The SEC's Division of Examinations has named advanced technologies such as superintelligence, alongside tokenization risks, as areas of focus. The excerpt is brief and gives no further detail.
items.sourceTitle: SEC Flags AI 'Super Intelligence' and Tokenization as Systemic Market Risks

items.headline: Initia pauses its blockchain after reported exploit
items.summary: The Initia network suspended its layer-1 chain and rollups after security researchers flagged unauthorized token minting and asset transfers to Ethereum. The reported losses are said to exceed $2.6 million.
items.sourceTitle: Initia halts blockchain after exploit reportedly drains over $2.6M

items.headline: Spot Bitcoin ETFs see $635M outflows as BTC nears cost basis
items.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded about $635 million in net outflows on Thursday, the largest daily outflow since June 25, as bitcoin traded near the estimated cost basis of the funds' holdings. The withdrawals reversed nearly 60% of the inflows from the prior three sessions.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin ETFs shed $635 million as BTC tests their holdings’ estimated $81,500 cost basis

items.headline: Bitcoin Core Updates Security Policy Amid AI-Driven Bug Discovery
items.summary: Bitcoin Core developers will now backport fixes and release updates immediately for flaws considered easily discoverable, dropping long embargo periods. The change responds to bugs that an attacker could find with a single AI prompt.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin Core Rewrites Its Security Policy for a World Where AI Finds Bugs in One Prompt

items.headline: Bitcoin Core Shortens Disclosure Timelines for AI-Discoverable Bugs
items.summary: Bitcoin Core will now fast-track fixes and disclosures for vulnerabilities that AI tools can easily rediscover, moving away from long embargo periods. The change applies to those bugs.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin Core Ends Long Embargoes for Bugs AI Can Rediscover

items.headline: Bitcoin ETFs See Large Outflows After Oil Price Jump
items.summary: Bitcoin ETFs reportedly lost more than $635 million in a single day, after investors who had been buying all week reversed course on Thursday. The excerpt does not give further detail on the cause.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin ETFs Lose Over $635M In One Day Following Oil Price Spike
